name: Faviamo needle cartridge
shortDescription: Precise, stable needle cartridge for professional permanent makeup, with a feminine heart-shaped design. 20 pcs/box, individually sterile-packed.
description:
A precise, stable needle cartridge for professional permanent makeup. Its distinctive heart-shaped design gives it a truly feminine, unique look, while ensuring even pigment delivery and well-controlled work.

Available sizes: 0.25 mm 1RL, 0.25 mm 3RL, 0.30 mm 1RL, 0.30 mm 3RL, 0.35 mm 1RL.

Each box contains 20 single-use needle cartridges, individually sterile-packed.
metaTitle: Faviamo needle cartridge – 20 sterile PMU needles, 1RL and 3RL
metaDescription: Faviamo needle cartridges for professional PMU: even pigment delivery, feminine heart-shaped design. 20 pcs/box, individually sterile, 0.25–0.35 mm.

faq.question: Which sizes are available?
faq.answer: The Faviamo needle cartridge comes in five sizes: 0.25 mm 1RL, 0.25 mm 3RL, 0.30 mm 1RL, 0.30 mm 3RL, 0.35 mm 1RL. You can choose the size on the product page before adding it to the cart.

faq.question: How many cartridges are in a box?
faq.answer: Each box contains 20 needle cartridges, each individually sterile-packed.

faq.question: How many times can a cartridge be used?
faq.answer: The cartridges are single-use: for hygiene reasons, a new cartridge must be used for every treatment.

whatsIncluded: 20 Faviamo needle cartridges in the selected size
